verdict.rationale: Granola documents some background automations that run without the user in the loop. Users can set up HubSpot auto-sync so notes added to folders are saved to CRM records, and an official Zapier integration lets them automate what happens after a meeting. Built-in behaviors also run on their own: overnight pre-meeting briefs, automatic follow-up email drafts and automatic enhanced-note generation. However, there is no general user-defined automation or agent builder: Chat workflows require a review step, and custom agents must be built on the API. Missing for 10: a native configurable automation or trigger builder, user-scheduled recurring agent tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration that the automations run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.
Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting
Granola preps you for your meetings overnight.
After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email
Once Granola has recognised your call has ended, or you stop it manually, it will automatically generate enhanced notes.
